svg.text: a tile is split when its geometric error,
seen from the camera, exceeds 16 px
level 0: 2,000 m tile, geometric error 64 m
level 1: 1,000 m tile, geometric error 32 m
level 2: 500 m tile, geometric error 16 m
level 3: 250 m tile, geometric error 8 m
level 4: 125 m tile, geometric error 4 m
numbers: each drawn tile’s error on screen
far tiles stay coarse; near ones refine
